route: Pas Kerja (work pass) and work visa

permit.applies: The employment agency's representative files the work visa and pass application with the Immigration and National Registration Department on the employer's or sponsor's letter; the work visa approval goes to Brunei's mission abroad, where the worker has it endorsed.
permit.first: The Labour Department's foreign worker licence (LPA, form BUR 500), its licence to recruit foreign workers and its job order.

fees.what: Multiple visa, up to three months
Multiple visa, three to twelve months

sources.title: Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan (Brunei), Bahagian Pas Kerja
sources.said: Surat permohonan dari majikan atau penjamin diperlukan bagi warganegara Singapura, Malaysia dan warganegara asing yang lain. … Lesen Pekerja Asing (LPA)/Borang BUR 500 dan Lesen Pengambilan Pekerja Asing dari Jabatan Buruh (asal dan salinan) mestilah disertakan oleh semua kategori pemohon. Pesanan Kerja (Job Order) dari Jabatan Buruh dan Kad Wakil Agensi Pekerjaan diperlukan bagi warganegara Singapura, Malaysia dan warganegara asing yang lain. … Wakil agensi pekerjaan terlebih dahulu menghadapkan permohonan visa dan pas kerja ke Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan Surat kebenaran visa kerja akan dikeluarkan Kebenaran visa kerja akan disalurkan kepada Perwakilan Negara Brunei Darussalam di luar negeri

sources.title: Bahagian Pas Kerja (Work Pass Section), Immigration and National Registration Department, Brunei Darussalam: Work Pass Section briefing (2023), copy published by Thailand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.said: 1. Approval of Labour Licence for employing foreign workers from the Labour Department … VISA FEE … $20.00 … $30.00 … $50.00
